key.name: show-past
key.description: Also shows the last two finished and the currently running appointment, at 50% opacity.

key.name: hide-calendar-grid
key.description: Hides the month calendar in the date menu, leaving the header and the appointment list. Off is GNOME's default.

key.name: event-count
key.description: How many of the next appointments the list shows.

key.name: lookahead-days
key.description: How far ahead the calendar service is queried. Automatically widened when the period contains too few appointments.

key.name: show-all-day
key.description: Include birthdays, holidays and other all-day entries.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Records which appointments were shown and which period was queried — for debugging (journalctl --user -b | grep calendar-preview).
